context: Request: due-diligence memos from the firm's healthcare-services M&A deals (hospital systems, provider groups, etc.). Rubric: 1001-00003, 1001-00007, 1006-00008 and their diligence memos (12 criteria).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell listing of folders and a file sample, both cut by head limits; the sample includes files of two candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts matters and files and lists every file in diligence folders (395 files, ~64K chars).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for sector words run in parallel per series, then greps of the saved hits by matter and with snippets (~71K chars).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the diligence folders of five candidate matters and greps the saved hits for diligence-folder files.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Reopened: lists memo-like files in eleven candidate matters without the folder filter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads diligence memos and opening memos from nine candidates, then the remaining memos of the three it keeps, and one more matter's letter, listing and memo.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. A store-wide file-name sweep and term counts, then filtered listings and engagement-letter openings of six more candidates to rule them out.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three matters with their diligence memos and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Checks cited paths, edits a caveat and re-reads the top.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction scan over diligence-folder documents for sector and deal terms, then an edit to the completeness note.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Reopened: edits the completeness note and rechecks paths.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Scan document text with an extraction script → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents

divergence: All three runs passed with the same procedure: after the capped glob, a store-wide extraction scan for sector words (two timed out with large partial output) and file-name searches for diligence-named files surfaced the three needed matters early; each listed candidate folders, read the diligence memos of about ten candidates, kept the same three matters, read all their memos, ruled out further candidates in reopened screening stages, and wrote the answer. Reviews kept flagging unopened candidates, which the runs answered with extra screening rounds.
